p2_findings.title: Traceability enforcer default scope silently skips two failing plans
p2_findings.exploit_scenario: Developer runs python3 tools/traceability-enforcer.py, sees exit 0 (PASSED), and believes all FRs are traced — missing coverage for 27 FRs goes undetected in pre-commit/CI gates
p2_findings.recommendation: Update enforcer to scan all Plans/**/requirements.md and fail if any plan has missing FRs; OR update CLAUDE.md gate to enumerate all plans explicitly

p2_findings.title: Route handlers bypass service layer — direct store calls in 3 route files

p2_findings.recommendation: Extract workItemService.ts; move store interactions there; route handlers call service only
